definitions.explanation: A condition that impairs normal physical or mental functions. Can range from minor to serious.

notes:
{病気|びょうき} refers to illness or disease, covering both minor and serious conditions.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {病気|びょうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to get sick
- {病気|びょうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{治|なお}る→治る：19598_naoru⟧: to recover from illness
- {病気|びょうき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧: to be absent due to illness
